title: RuneScape Dragonwilds: Black Knight's Fortress Quest Guide – All Shards, Puzzle & Boss Solutions!
author: RuneScape Universe
description:
RuneScape Dragonwilds Black Knight's Fortress Quest Guide

Need help completing the Black Knight's Fortress quest in RuneScape Dragonwilds? In this complete walkthrough, I'll show you how to unlock Umbral Sands, collect all 13 Dreaming Stone Shards, complete every required puzzle, defeat powerful enemies including Blue Dragons, Lesser Demons, and the Titan boss, and finish the quest as quickly as possible.

This guide covers the entire quest from start to finish, including shard locations, puzzle solutions, safe spots, gear recommendations, boss mechanics, and useful shortcuts.

Thanks for watching! 🎮
Subscribe for more RuneScape Dragonwilds and OSRS adventures.
